# FlowSpring

> Community water safety network. Report unsafe water in 90 seconds, view a live incident map, and route reports to NGOs and authorities. Aligned with UN SDG 6.

FlowSpring lets residents file geo-tagged reports about contaminated water, broken pipes, dry taps, sewage overflow, and chemical smells. The community verifies reports, NGOs and field agents triage them, and resolutions are tracked publicly.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What FlowSpring is and how to get started.
- [Dashboard](/home): Nearby incidents, district safety score, and recent alerts.
- [Incident Map](/map): Live map of reported water incidents with filters.
- [Report an Incident](/report): File a water safety report with photo and location.
- [Test Your Water — Guide](/guide/test-water): How to test home water quality and read the results.
